probes.name: PS1
probes.subject: tools/goal_template.py
probes.note: The override is read under the wrong name, so it is silently ignored and the checkout's state dir comes back. This is the pre-fix renderer in function form.

probes.name: PS2
probes.subject: tools/goal_template.py
probes.old: return Path(override) if override else repo_root / ".claude" / "state"
probes.new: return Path(override) if override else repo_root / ".claude" / "stat"
probes.note: The default drifts. Without this, a renderer that re-rooted EVERY run would pass the override case and quietly move production goal state.

probes.name: PS3
probes.subject: tools/goal_template.py
probes.old: return Path(override) if override else repo_root / ".claude" / "state"
probes.new: return Path(override) if override is not None else repo_root / ".claude" / "state"
probes.note: An empty value becomes Path(''), which is the working directory; the default case stays green because it passes no key at all.
